RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither does it rule out discrimination. You and the successful candidate are both women; nothing described specifically indicates sex bias.

Your qualifications warrant asking how the published criteria were applied, but the announcement may omit relevant credentials, and consultation or leadership experience may have carried substantial weight.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on your assessment. Check applicable recruitment-review deadlines now. Raise panel composition only if connected to specific evidence of bias or a breached appointment rule—not as a standalone allegation.
